text: By the way, in the new code of laws which I suppose it will be necessary for you to make, I desire you would remember the ladies and be more generous and favorable to them than your ancestors. Do not put such unlimited power into the hands of the husbands. Remember, all men would be tyrants if they could.
author: Abigail Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 91, Abigail Adams to John Adams, Braintree, 31 March, 1776
